answer.outline: One request can be correlated across logs and metrics; an injected test failure increments the expected signal; secrets are excluded from diagnostic output.
suggested_steps: Use a trusted/generated request ID rather than blindly trusting any client header.
Measure count, latency and error rate separately.
Set alert thresholds based on baseline and avoid logging tokens or full cookies.
